# Loyalty Tier

## Summary
A member's standing on an ordered ladder. Shared-realm block at
`loyalty-tier-field.gts`. A tier differs from a status in one structural way:
tiers are ORDERED — priority windows, earning multipliers and upgrade prompts
all compare positions, so rank helpers are part of the block and consumers
never string-compare tier names.

## API
- `loyaltyTierField(config)` — factory; returns a FieldDef bound to one ladder. Options in rank order (lowest first): `{ value, label?, hue?, multiplier?, meaning? }`
- `LoyaltyTierField` (default export) — neutral Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum ladder for consumers without a program yet
- Helpers against the returned class: `tierRank`, `tierAtLeast(value, minimum)` (the priority-window question), `nextTier` (what an upgrade prompt offers), `tierOption`, `tierMultiplier`
- `TierBadge` — the rendered form; per-tier theme-token hooks `--tier-<slug>-bg/-fg/-ring` let an app's theme hand its ladder a metallic treatment

## Usage
```ts
import { loyaltyTierField } from '../loyalty-tier-field';

const MemberTierField = loyaltyTierField({
  displayName: 'Membership Tier',
  options: [
    { value: 'Bronze', hue: 'orange', multiplier: 1 },
    { value: 'Silver', hue: 'slate', multiplier: 1.5 },
    { value: 'Gold', hue: 'amber', multiplier: 2 },
  ],
});
@field tier = contains(MemberTierField);
```

## Example
Serializes as a plain string (the tier value), so `containedExamples` cannot
hold one — the linked Loyalty Account carries `Gold` on the neutral ladder
in use.

## Non-goals
The field stores standing, not the earning of it: thresholds, upgrades and
downgrades are a points engine's moves (Credit Points and its siblings), and
`multiplier` is stored only so every consumer quotes the same published rate.
Tier history belongs on the member card as event facts (`tierSince`), not
here.
